scope: bounded deterministic logical event scheduling, total tie order and event-budget rejection; no physical clock, interrupt or hard real-time claim; actual monotonic timer release and asynchronous native RCL process with source-owned sampled-deadline publication, cancellation/exit observation and failure settlement; local soft realtime, no hard OS interrupt/timing guarantee or external effects

independentGeneration.requestedToolPolicy: read only named frozen candidates; no other filesystem, memory, network, tools or writes

runtimeControls: actual monotonic timers and asynchronous native process exit
RCL-owned admission/publication and full independent controller replay
release wait, bounded backpressure, past-deadline/time-reversal/source-authority rejection, native timeout/cancel and healthy recovery
authorityProfile: RCL conditional warrants own local sampled-deadline publication; Node transports clock observations, stops owned processes and waits for real exit; no hard realtime/OS interruption guarantee

trials.intent: Sort events by increasing time, then increasing priority value, then increasing identifier, using a total deterministic order.
Reject an advance when the count of due active events exceeds the event budget; equality is allowed.
An external time proposal requires temporal commit capability equal to one and cannot move logical time backwards.
